bug: record_order currently overwrites an existing order when the same key is submitted twice. Repeated keys must return the first stored record unchanged, even when the new payload differs. This is a synthetic StudioNet test, not production order processing.
requirements: For an existing key, record_order must return the existing stored object without replacing or mutating it, even when the new payload differs.
For a previously unseen nonempty string key, record_order must store a shallow dict copy of the supplied payload and return that stored object.
A non-string or empty/whitespace-only key must raise ValueError before modifying the orders dictionary.
